Interactive viewer to pick spots on the tissue

Source: R/R-viewer.R
view_spots.Rd

Draws the spots of a SpatialExperiment object on an interactive plotly map, on top of the slide image when there is one, to pick spots and retrieve their identifiers and coordinates.

Usage

view_spots(
  spe,
  color_by = NULL,
  image = TRUE,
  sample_id = NULL,
  image_id = NULL,
  image_file = NULL,
  scale_factor = NULL,
  point_size = 6,
  alpha = 0.8,
  flip_y = NULL,
  max_px = 2000,
  file = NULL
)

Arguments

spe

A SpatialExperiment object.

color_by

Optional name of a `colData` column used to colour the spots. Numeric columns use a continuous scale, other columns one colour per value. If `NULL` (default), spots are not coloured: only their outline is drawn over the slide image.

image

Logical. Draw the slide image? Default is `TRUE`. If the image stored in the object is missing or cannot be read, the map is drawn without it.

sample_id

Sample to display. Required if `spe` holds several samples.

image_id

Optional `image_id` in `imgData(spe)`. By default, the first image of the sample is used.

image_file

Optional path to a slide image, used instead of the one stored in the object (e.g., when the stored path is no longer valid).

scale_factor

Optional numeric. Image pixels per `spatialCoords` unit. By default, taken from the selected row of `imgData(spe)`. Set it if the image has another resolution (1 for a full-resolution image).

point_size

Numeric. Marker size in screen pixels. Default is 6.

alpha

Numeric between 0 and 1. Opacity of coloured spots. Default is 0.8.

flip_y

Logical. Draw the y axis downwards, as in image coordinates? By default, `TRUE` if an image is drawn and `FALSE` otherwise. This only affects the display, never the coordinates returned. `FALSE` is not allowed with an image.

max_px

Integer. Images larger than this are shrunk to keep the page light. Default is 2000.

file

Optional path of a self-contained HTML page to write.

Value

A plotly htmlwidget.

Details

Hovering a spot shows its identifier, coordinates and `color_by` value. Clicking a spot adds it to the selection, and clicking it again removes it. The box and lasso tools add all enclosed spots. A panel gives the R code to copy: a `spots` vector of identifiers and, for one or two spots, data frames `A` and `B` that can be passed to [build_one_trajectory()] or [build_similar_trajectories()].

Spot identifiers are taken from the `spot_id` column of `colData` if present, otherwise from `colnames(spe)`.

This function needs the suggested packages SpatialExperiment, plotly and htmlwidgets, and magick and base64enc to draw the slide image.

Examples

data("visium_simulated_spe", package = "Battlefield")
if (requireNamespace("plotly", quietly = TRUE) &&
    requireNamespace("htmlwidgets", quietly = TRUE)) {
    # No colour
    view_spots(visium_simulated_spe)
    # Coloured by a colData column
    view_spots(visium_simulated_spe, color_by = "cluster")
}
